note: Both sets correctly capture the single well-supported fact (approximately 100 issues and concerns across the four mission concepts from initial LCIT reviews of the Draft Final Reports). Both then repeat the value 100 misbound to the wrong property: A claims 100 findings for the Draft Final Reports and 100 mission concepts, while B claims a 'resultant mission concepts count' of 100 and likewise 100 mission concepts — all contradicted by the source, which states four mission concepts and that 100 is the number of issues/concerns. B's second claim is additionally garbled (entity 'LCIT Process (2) Draft Final Reports', condition 'approximately', fragmentary quote), making it the least faithful of the six. Neither set captures the other page facts (e.g., significant reduction of remaining issues).
